### less() {#aec7a7a1abbcf26f495eb5057cb42f311}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">

<td class="doxyMemberName">bool GCNRegPressure::less (<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/aarch64/aarch64promoteconstant-cpp/#a90f8350fecae261c25be85d38b451bff">const</a> <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machinefunction">MachineFunction</a> &amp; MF, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/aarch64/aarch64promoteconstant-cpp/#a90f8350fecae261c25be85d38b451bff">const</a> <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/gcnregpressure">GCNRegPressure</a> &amp; O, unsigned MaxOccupancy=std::numeric_limits&lt; unsigned &gt;<a href="#a777faac6be71de27de30acdd1a8f1a4e">::max</a>())</td>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Compares <span class="doxyComputerOutput">this</span> GCNRegpressure to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">O</span>, returning true if <span class="doxyComputerOutput">this</span> is less.</p>


<p>Since GCNRegpressure contains different types of pressures, and due to target-specific pecularities (e.g. we care about occupancy rather than raw register usage), we determine if <span class="doxyComputerOutput">this</span> <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/gcnregpressure">GCNRegPressure</a> is less than <span class="doxyComputerOutput">O</span> based on the following tiered comparisons (in order order of precedence):</p>


<ol class="doxyList" type="1">
<li>Better occupancy</li>
<li>Less spilling (first preference to VGPR spills, then to SGPR spills)</li>
<li>Less tuple register pressure (first preference to VGPR tuples if we determine that SGPR pressure is not important)</li>
<li>Less raw register pressure (first preference to VGPR tuples if we determine that SGPR pressure is not important)</li>
</ol>

<p>References <a href="#a70cc3973bc07308e03b0dada52c381b5">GCNRegPressure</a>, <a href="#ab822633324180bbee7b05a0d2518c563">getAGPRNum</a>, <a href="#abd577f5d55cd0fde5973c8c5a1cdb816">getSGPRNum</a>, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machinefunction/#a3825368aca2bc1550d173660df4da6a6">llvm::MachineFunction::getSubtarget</a> and <a href="#a6b5acc4933b30383d7b31729281dacc3">getVGPRNum</a>.</p>
